title: Holy Halo
text: Process one Light Microcore through advanced condensation to obtain a Holy Halo.
Place a Holy Halo in a modifier slot. Damage and healing gain a separate x1.5 multiplier; duplicate Holy modifiers do not multiply again. Sustained potion effects are unchanged.

Contacts ignite hostile creatures for 10 seconds and make neutral/allied creatures glow for 10 seconds. Angry neutral mobs count as hostile. Base Holy cloud damage is 1.5 per second; lifesteal receives another x1.5, rounded up.
